text: Updated $ANT w/ 3Q figures. Some changes: - Nailed the 3Q Revenue figure (came in within 0.1%). Year over year growth mind blowing but sequentially the slowdown is notable - Compute & Infra expense as % of Net Revenues jumps to 58% (from 48% in 2Q). Personnel expenses, sales & marketing is down to offset this, but pretty big jump in my opinion given Revenues slowed down sequentially - On the above, implied 3Q R&D expense (~$9.5B) was basically equal to what they spent through 1Q & 2Q (~$9.7B), and higher than the annual R&D expense from all the previous years (for ex/ 2025 total R&D expense ~$6.3B). Rumor is Fable 5.5 is dropping soon, and is supposedly mindblowingly good. I bet the model drops soon and everyone will stop scrutinizing their numbers and focus shifts to how good the model is / how far ahead they are in the frontier race - $1.96B "non-cash charitable contributions" expense drives most of their "adjustments" in 3Q. One of the benefits of working at Anthropic is they match their employees' charitable contributions, which I never modeled as a recurring expense given it was $0 in 2Q, and I've left it out in the forecasts (which is why 4Q margins nosedive) for now - They disclose $895.4B in commitments, but from their per Company disclosure and other ancillary filings I get to $695.3B, weighted avg. over 7 years. A lot of these are "minimum spend" so that plus other undisclosed stuff is what probably bridges to the $895.4B - On the above, Google's commitment rose +$6.8B between S-1 filings, others stayed the same
